revisions.reason: Batch-6 follow-up: located the official preview announcement (blog.google/deepmind, 2026-03-03, canonical URL) carrying Arena.ai 1432 Elo / GPQA Diamond 86.9% / MMMU Pro 76.8% in prose — the same numbers earlier marked secondary-only. Rows sourced from the preview post; release_date kept at GA (2026-05-08) per GA-date convention.

notes: Two official dates bound this model: PREVIEW 2026-03-03 (blog.google/deepmind announcement, publishedTime 2026-03-03T16:34Z — the source of all three evidence rows) and GA 2026-05-07/08 (cloud.google.com publishedTime 2026-05-08T02:00+0100 = 05-07 PT; OpenRouter created 2026-05-07; API changelog '2026-05-07 GA'). release_date stays the GA date per the library's GA-date convention (same treatment as gemini-2-5-flash). The GA page itself still contains zero benchmarks (enterprise customer metrics only — Gladly ~60% lower costs, p95 ~1.8s, ~99.6% success — operational figures, kept here). Preview-post extras in prose but non-benchmark: 2.5x faster TTFT and 45% higher output speed vs 2.5 Flash per Artificial Analysis; $0.25/$1.50 per 1M pricing; thinking levels standard. The preview-post comparison table (vs Gemini 2.5 Dynamic / 2.5 Flash-Lite / GPT-5 mini / Claude 4.5 Haiku / Grok 4.1 Fast) is a GIF image — not machine-read. The 2026-07-21 family post later publishes this model's TB 2.1 31% / GDM-MRCR v2 60.1% / GDPVal-AA v2 642 as baseline column values (recorded there, on that release).
